text:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends decided to climb a big tree. Timmy was scared because the tree was so big and strong. 

Suddenly, Timmy lost his balance and fell off the tree. His friends ran to him and helped him up. Timmy was ashamed that he lost his friends but he was safe now. 

Timmy learned that it's important to be careful and not stay on things that can hurt you. From that day on, he was more careful when playing outside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play games with her friends. One day, Lily's mom brought out lots of yummy treats from the store. Lily was so happy and excited to eat them all.

After eating, Lily and her friends decided to play a game of hide-and-seek. Lily was a good seeker and she found a great hiding spot. She peeked behind the couch and waited for her friends to find her.

But when everyone went to look for her, Lily felt embarrassed. She didn't want to show up again and keep her friends behind. So, she just walked away and didn't come out. Her mom and dad came to find her and they were so proud of her for being so good at hiding.
